description: Play / listen to / put on ONE specific song the user already has — returns a fresh, clickable stream link for that track by its id. The user normally refers to a track by NAME, not id: when the requested title is approximate, partial, or possibly misspelled, FIRST call list_tracks (request the full library, e.g. limit 100), pick the closest matching title, then call this tool with its id. If several tracks plausibly match, list them and ask the user which one rather than guessing. Never invent a track id. (To browse or show the whole library, use list_tracks; to create a new song, use generate_track.)
name: play_track
title: Play a song
